title: Add OpenAI API-native model adapter
description:
Why: ADR 0010 establishes that API-native adapters are the preferred clean architecture, and OpenAI is the first non-Anthropic provider targeted for gameplay. An OpenAI adapter would enable API-key-native gameplay via the OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions API, with Eshyra owning the turn loop, tool declaration, tool execution, and diagnostics — matching the pattern of AnthropicNativeModelClient. This bead is the follow-up created by eshyra-ckrg as required by the scope section.

What needs to be done:
1. Implement OpenAiNativeModelClient in packages/core/src/model/openaiNativeClient.ts following the AnthropicNativeModelClient pattern.
2. Use the OpenAI Node SDK (or fetch directly). Convert ModelToolDefinition[] to OpenAI tool declarations. Parse tool_calls from the response into ModelToolCall[]. Map stop reasons to ModelStopReason.
3. Expose capabilities: { adapterFamily: 'api-native', toolTransport: 'api-native', turnLoopOwner: 'eshyra', vendor: 'openai', gameplayCapable: true }.
4. Add OpenAI to PROVIDER_IDS in profiles.ts and wire a premium_dm profile entry.
5. Add offline unit tests (mock the SDK) matching the AnthropicNativeModelClient test coverage.
6. Export the new adapter from packages/core/src/index.ts.
7. Document in docs/agent-sdk-auth.md or a new docs/openai-auth.md how to configure OPENAI_API_KEY.
8. Update README 'Supported Provider Modes' section to list the OpenAI adapter.

Out of scope here: Codex SDK subscription adapter (see eshyra-jl8n/eshyra-dcln).
close_reason: Implemented and wired OpenAiNativeModelClient with native tool transport, offline coverage, and provider documentation.
